name: vless-vps
description: Xray VLESS + Bun subscription server with 6-day Let's Encrypt IP certs and one-command UUID rotation

scripts.deploy:sub: scp -P ${VLESS_SSH_PORT:-65455} src/vless-sub-server.ts ${VLESS_SSH_TARGET:?set VLESS_SSH_TARGET=user@host}:/usr/local/bin/vless-sub-server.ts && ssh -p ${VLESS_SSH_PORT:-65455} ${VLESS_SSH_TARGET} 'chmod 700 /usr/local/bin/vless-sub-server.ts && systemctl restart vless-sub'
